scope: Post-mitigation analysis of existing real Nautilus trials; no new experiment or scheduler change.

definitions.decision: Common scheduled decision at evaluation second 60.
definitions.activation: Recorded assignment confirmation, which can follow actual processing resumption. Keep 3 uses second 60 as its reference.
definitions.decision_cohort: Created before and acknowledged by the decision, but not completed then, including warm-up messages.
definitions.activation_cohort: Acknowledged by activation and not completed then, including messages produced during preparation and handover.
definitions.cohort_latency: Creation to earliest completion by drain cutoff. Unfinished messages remain in the cohort denominator.
definitions.service: First 30 seconds after confirmed activation; physical processing starts retain replays, throughput counts earliest distinct completions.
definitions.limitation: Consumer buffers and consume-call boundaries were not logged. Coexistence of old and new work does not prove both were locally available. Timestamp comparisons retain clock uncertainty.
definitions.comparison: Activation-aligned windows begin at different absolute times and queue ages. Report common-decision times alongside them. Observed service is not a calibrated capacity.
